import markdown from "@eslint/markdown";
import plugin from "eslint-plugin-prose-spellcheck";
import fixture from "./fixture.json" with { type: "json" };

const namespace = fixture.namespace ?? "prose-spellcheck";

export default [
  { ignores: ["ignored.md"] },
  {
    files: ["**/*.md"],
    plugins: { markdown, [namespace]: plugin },
    language: `markdown/${fixture.language ?? "gfm"}`,
    languageOptions: { frontmatter: "yaml" },
    rules: {
      ...(!fixture.noRule ? {
        [`${namespace}/spellcheck`]: fixture.omitOptions
          ? fixture.severity ?? "error"
          : [fixture.severity ?? "error", fixture.options],
      } : {}),
      ...fixture.rules,
    },
  },
];
